acceptanceCriteria: complete accepts a commit that is reachable from the configured remote-tracking main (or a fetched origin/main) when the local main branch is behind, or the refusal names a supported recovery that does not require moving a checked-out branch with unrelated staged work.
The STALE_TREE refusal's reason is carried in the codes/items, not only as a free-text warning.
body: Observed 2026-10-10 closing V1-1053/V1-1060 after beamfall/corvint#711 merged as 684cca5f. Native claim (0.65 s), submit and gate run focused-docs succeeded; complete --commit 684cca5f refused STALE_TREE with warning 'commit ... is not reachable from main'. The primary checkout holds the store under .git/taskman, its main is behind origin/main, and it carries ~2000 unrelated staged changes, so fast-forwarding main is not safe. Only workaround: release the attempt and complete-manual citing the gate result digest, which the native-lifecycle preference (claim->submit->gate run->complete) is meant to avoid. corvint-tasks version: installed local build.
title: corvint-tasks complete refuses STALE_TREE for a merged commit when the local main checkout is behind origin/main
